Round flags for the chart's economic-event markers (29 Oct 2026): HatScripts circle-flags 2.8.0, MIT (LICENSE.md), as published,
byte for byte. us = United States (USD), eu = European Union (EUR), gb = United Kingdom (GBP), jp = Japan (JPY), ch = Switzerland (CHF),
au = Australia (AUD), ca = Canada (CAD), nz = New Zealand (NZD), cn = China (CNY).
